Bettina, the note to June Osei-Lark is saved as a mail draft with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's addressed to joseilark@pemberline.com and hasn't been sent.

It uses Sofia's bullets plus your addition: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I signed it from you. I left out the line about the February relabel follow-ups, since it didn't belong in a note to June. I also posted a short confirmation in #coastal-team.
